in_marathi.name: Umesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Rain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Umesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ushma’ meaning ‘rain’ and ‘Ishana’ meaning ‘lord’. Umesh represents the god of rain and is often associated with the monsoon season and new beginnings.

in_bengali.name: Umesh

in_bengali.long_meaning: Umesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ushma’ meaning ‘rain’ and ‘Ishana’ meaning ‘lord’. Umesh represents the god of rain and is often associated with the monsoon season and new beginnings.

vedic_reference.note: Umesh is a common name in Hinduism and is derived from the name of the goddess Uma, who is often depicted as the dark night sky, and the prefix Ish, which means conquered. Umesh is thus a symbolic name for the one who has conquered the darkness.
